requestGates.rationale: Each accepted new text requires one real publish; retries are reported separately. Read/preparation budgets remain uncalibrated and are reported, never silently baselined.

latency.targetRationale: Proposed loopback recipient-presentation target, independent of observed lag; requires owner review and equivalent controlled candidate/reference calibration before gating.
latency.status: Calibration pending; failure deadlines are not acceptable latency targets.
